notes.text: Lists this account's available feature metadata; id, name and integer is_plugin fields may be omitted. Third-party feature IDs are not a closed enumeration.

evidence.note: Pinned /Features/has_feature responses/200/content/application~1json/examples/does-not-have-feature and exists-but-acct-does-not-have show status=0, errors=null and data=null for unavailable features; has-feature shows status=1 with data=null. UAPI status carries the feature-access outcome rather than an API error, so use unchecked for UAPI only. Outer WHM outcome checking remains mandatory.

notes.text: This operation uses UAPI status as the feature-access result: inspect responseMeta()->uapiStatus() after the call (1 means enabled; 0 means absent or disabled). A UAPI status of 0 is accepted; an outer WHM bridge failure still throws.

The pinned data schema is a nullable opaque object, with null in the documented access examples. Preserve explicit null and object fields; absent data is a payload mismatch. No boolean payload is invented.

Only enabled matching features count. has_matching_features remains an optional integer 0/1 flag; the entire result may be null. Omitted isRegex preserves the server default; false is sent explicitly as 0.
Returns only enabled feature names that match the pattern. Preserve the distinct null and empty-list results; omission of isRegex leaves the default in effect, while false sends 0.
